definitions.explanation: The total amount of money earned in a year.

examples.english: My annual income is 5 million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}して→転職する：04557_tenshoku⟧{年収|ねんしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: My annual income increased after changing jobs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧{年収|ねんしゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いくら→いくら：00943_ikura⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
examples.english: What is the average annual income?

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}して→転職する：04557_tenshoku⟧{年収|ねんしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My annual income increased after changing jobs, but the work became harder than before.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年収|ねんしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This company is popular because the annual income is high.

notes:
{年収|ねんしゅう} means annual income or yearly earnings, including all forms of compensation before taxes.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧: year
- ⟦{収|しゅう}→収：noentry⟧: income, earnings (from ⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧)

INCOME-RELATED TERMS:
- {年収|ねんしゅう}: annual income (gross, before deductions)
- ⟦{月収|げっしゅう}→月収：12999_gesshuu⟧: monthly income
- ⟦{手取|てど}り→手取り：06833_tedori⟧: take-home pay (net, after deductions)
- ⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧: income (general term)
- ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧: salary, pay
- ⟦{給与|きゅうよ}→給与：00264_kyuuyo⟧: salary, wages (formal)
- ⟦ボーナス→ボーナス：05878_boonasu⟧: bonus

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {年収|ねんしゅう}500⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: annual income of 5 million yen
- ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧{年収|ねんしゅう}: average annual income
- {年収|ねんしゅう}⟦アップ→アップ：00005_appu⟧: salary increase
- {年収|ねんしゅう}⟦ベース→ベース：08762_beesu⟧: on an annual basis

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, salaries are typically discussed in terms of {年収|ねんしゅう} rather than monthly pay. Job listings often show {年収|ねんしゅう}, which usually includes bonuses (⟦{賞与|しょうよ}→賞与：04694_shouyo⟧).
